name: Achievement Hunter: Zombie
summary:
Dive into the heart-pounding action of Achievement Hunter: Zombie, a thrilling 2D action shooter where you are the last line of defense against a relentless horde of the undead. A desperate struggle for survival awaits as you step into the boots of a lone hero determined to protect their home.

Unlike other zombie survival games, you won't find any allies here. It's just you, your skill, and a growing arsenal of real weapons against an overwhelming zombie invasion. Fight your way through waves of enemies, showcasing your shooter prowess and strategic thinking.
